notes.title: Version 1.1.1STM the winter update is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we here at TyBug Studios are proud to bring you the winter update of PEP for 2023!

---LIMITED TIME MODE--
Added - Snowball fight LTM. This new LTM removes the guns and replaces them with snowballs full of rocks! Gather snow from piles on the ground in the winter version of refinery and chuck them at your friends or enemies in this PVP mode.


---NEW SKIN---
Added - Festive23, Frozen weapons skins for the all Base Weapons, with a ice crystal muzzle flash, and blue frozen tracers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144917/8c9492cddef94bd7bbafd81501a08117cd01974f.gif[/img]


---NEW WEAPONS---
Added - AK12 Rifle, This new rifle is perfect for mid range encounters with its attached sight.
Added - HAK Rifle, The damage of 7.62x54mmR will make up for a lack of ammo in the magazine.
Added - M9 Pistol, This new pistol is burst fire only which is perfect for quick close range combat. 
Added - SBR MR, This New MR has a shorter barrel which makes Aiming and movement much faster.
Added - M1A MR, This new MR has a long range scope with a range finder built in for accurate shooting.
Added - Bolter Shotgun, This new auto shotgun coming in .410Gauge is great at destroying hordes.


---MAPS---
Added - winter decorations to Decatur!
Added - winter decorations to Refinery!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144917/b2d115872e6438dd3e09004e0e059f9634b7e993.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144917/a884d68d7a16290d2f219575ba98dcd7a4e12498.png[/img]

---GENERAL--
Changed - Burst mode now requires a button press per burst.
Changed - Practice range to specify if weapon is Base or Special.
Changed - Practice range to allow player to explore whole base.
Changed - Practice range to not highlight friendly players.

General Performance Improvements.


As always we hope you enjoy the update, and if the update isn't available restart your steam client.

notes.title: SND, KOTH, And Version 0.8.1STM!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, Version 0.8.1STM is live!


--Gamemodes-- 
NEW - KOTH! King of the Hill is our first new mode, players must stand on an objective marker to earn points for their team, the more teammates on the objective the more points earned! But watch out, the objective can move around and change locations! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144917/a1b26d7ce24cb412f1118a416f1ee265f0fbb537.gif[/img]

NEW - SND! Search and Destroy is our second new mode, 2 teams face off in a critical situation for the survivor population of PEPs vast world as the Military Team attempts to plant and detonate a bomb in specific locations, the Survivors goal is to kill all the military or defuse the bomb to save their home! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144917/e478e7b5fce7cab4d2f7efd3a700eb1f1b058c1b.gif[/img]

Fixed - Explosive zombies using emerge points in horde. (was unfair as they could explode while emerging)

Changed - Horde Starting secondary to 1911 was PMM

--Maps-- 
NEW - Train Yard! Train Yard is our new map, set in an industrial Train Yard designed with plenty of height vantage points and small amounts of cover making it a medium range snipers dream! but watch out for all of the zombies workers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43144917/9aa4774e91d6221468deca0584196ba230ae346a.gif[/img]

Added - All Melee Weapons to Practice Range.

Fixed - weird collision in refinery.
Fixed - Practice range TVs having burger menus on them.
Fixed - Minor Collision issues on Trainyard, and warehouse.
Fixed - Players being able to get where they shouldn't in warehouse, Train yard, and witch's bayou.
Fixed - Minor occlusion errors in Refinery, warehouse, and practice range.
Fixed - world looking weird due to weather settings change.
Fixed - Some objects in city using wrong material.

--AI-- 
NEW - Alligators! Alligators have infested the Plantation Bayou, be on the lookout for these slow-moving hard-hitting creatures while playing on the Plantation map in horde mode! 

--Weapons-- 
NEW - MPX! The MPX is a new 9MM SMG with a high firerate and moderate damage found in loadout drops, Item Caches, and the Mystery Wagon. 

NEW - Crowbar! The Crowbar is our new melee weapon, with a moderate swing speed and a two-hit kill, look for these in loadout drops, Item Caches, and the Mystery Wagon. 

Fixed - Muzzle position on all guns
Fixed - RPG using wrong sound.
Fixed - RPG and homing rocket sounds not being tied to sound settings.

Changed - 1911 Material to look better
Changed - S12 firerate to 550 was 800.
Changed - S12 ADS firerate to 500 was 750
Changed - AK movement error to 4 was 3
Changed - AR movement error to 3.75 was 2.75
Changed - spaz movement error to 1.35 was 1.15
Changed - deagle movement error to 1.85 was 2
Changed -spaz movement error to 1.5 was 1.45
Changed - HAR movement error to 3.25 was 2.75
Changed - badger movement error to 2 was 2.75
Changed - ak74u movement error to 2.5 was 3
Changed - dragon movement error to 6 was 4

--General--
Added - Reload rebinding.

Fixed - Throwing knife bouncing off of enemies
Fixed - Issue that caused penetrate effect to be used when it didn't penetrate. 

Changed - Player kills are now worth $500 was $250

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
As always we hope you all enjoy and if the update isn't available restart steam!

SND! MPX! The MPX is a new 9MM SMG with a high firerate and moderate damage found in loadout drops, Item Caches, and the Mystery Wagon. 

Crowbar! The Crowbar is our new melee weapon, with a moderate swing speed and a two-hit kill, look for these in loadout drops, Item Caches, and the Mystery Wagon. 

--General-- 
We also have a vast amount of balance and performance changes coming that we will share more with once the update is live!

notes.content:
Hello Everyone, Version 0.7.62STM is live, we're excited to be sharing more of PEP world and story through the introduction of Outpost Perot, a small scale military base in the Bayou Perot of Sothern Louisiana. 

--New Mode and New Map!--
Added - Practice Range! with its own dedicated Map (Outpost Perot), Mode (Practice Range), and trials! The practice range contains time based target shooting, melee training, 1v1 PvP, and access to all the throwables and weapons of the main game!

In the future the practice range will feature leader boards for all of the trials, however; for now we are holding off on adding it to ensure the modes stability and that all times will be legitimate.

notes.title: PEP 0.7.0STM Is Live
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, The holiday event is over and with it come a whole new set of content!

--New Player Zombie!--
Zombie Dog! become a cute little zombie dog and control zombies in your territory with your commanding howls!

--New Skin Set!--
Radioactive skin pack! This skin pack adds a radioactive pulsing glow to your weapons, a watch that shows the radiation in the area, and turns your bullets tracers green!

--New Weapon!--
Badger suppressed SMG! This sub sonic .300 Blackout round is slow moving but hard hitting with its high firerate.

--New Melee!--
Stabbing! pressing F will result in a heavy melee attack, dealing 75 damage but only being able to hit one enemy at a time. Stabbing can also get the Headshot damage bonus!

--New Grenade!--
Radiation Bomb! This grenade explodes on impact with a flat surface leaving a puddle of radioactive waste and a radiation zone to go along with it, near direct impacts with the Radiation Bomb will instantly fill the targets radiation bar.

--New Item!--
Gasmask! Found in weapon caches the Gasmask is perfect for protecting against that awful radiation zone!

--Accessibility--
Added - Dark Flashbang Option. This will turn the White out effect of the flashbang to be black, for light sensitive users.

--Player--
Added - Players weapons will now drop when picking up a replacement weapon.

--Maps--
Fixed - Some overgrowth still having collision
Fixed - Windows having no collision and preventing breaking in large scale map.

--Weapons--
Fixed - M16 having acog in store and customization.

Added - ATV will now make tire skid sounds when e-breaking at fast enough speed.
Added - Players can now rebind Melee and Stab inputs.

Fixed - Player disconnecting while level loading will no longer stop game from continuing.

Fixed - GaskmaskOverlay will now render below ALL UI layers.
Fixed - Player Minimap icons not appearing if over 25 meters high.

Fixed - Loading Delay when disconnecting from a room on menu.

Changed - All zombie ability UI elements to use dark mode key binding icons
Changed - ATV engine audio range to be 20% less.
Changed - Player Corpse will now despawn 1 second before respawning player to avoid seeing where they spawned.
